content: कच्छः, -च्छम् .²1 Bank, margin, skirt, bordering region (whether near water or not); यमुनाकच्छमवतीर्णः <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; गन्धमादनकच्छोऽध्यासितः <ls>V. 5</ls>; <ls>Śi. 3. 80</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 16</ls>. .²2 A marsh, morass, fen. ‘जलप्रायमनूपं स्यात्पुंसि कच्छस्तथाविधः’ <ls>Nm.</ls> .²3 The hem of the lower garment tucked into the waist-band; see कक्षा. .²4 A part of boat. .²5 A particular part of a tortoise (in कच्छप). .²6 A tree, the timber of which is used for making furniture of (तुन्न, <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>नांदुरकी</ns>); <ls>Mb. 1. 70. 21</ls>. .²7 A populous region. .{@-च्छा@} .²1 A cricket. .²2 The plant Lycopodium Imbricatum (वाराही).
